test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A and B can do a job in 6 days. A alone can do it in 10 days. In how many days can B do it alone?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Work done per day is taken as 1 unit of work. Combined work rate minus individual work rate gives the remaining person’s work rate.

Now, A + B can complete the work in 6 days

⇒ Work rate of (A + B) = 1/6

A alone can complete the work in 10 days

⇒ Work rate of A = 1/10

Now, B’s work rate:

B = (A + B) − A

⇒ B = 1/6 − 1/10

Take LCM of 6 and 10 = 30

⇒ B = (5 − 3) / 30

⇒ B = 2 / 30

⇒ B = 1 / 15

So, B alone can finish the work in 15 days.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
